title: Detailed hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- top wooden cap -->
  <rect x="20" y="6" width="60" height="8" rx="3" fill="#D9772B"/>
  <rect x="20" y="6" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#F0A24A"/>
  <!-- bottom wooden cap -->
  <rect x="20" y="86" width="60" height="8" rx="3" fill="#D9772B"/>
  <rect x="20" y="86" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#F0A24A"/>
  <!-- supporting side posts -->
  <rect x="24" y="13" width="5" height="74" rx="2" fill="#B05A1E"/>
  <rect x="71" y="13" width="5" height="74" rx="2" fill="#B05A1E"/>
  <rect x="25" y="13" width="2" height="74" fill="#E08030"/>
  <rect x="72" y="13" width="2" height="74" fill="#E08030"/>
  <!-- top bulb glass, outlined in light cyan -->
  <path d="M30 14 Q30 22 38 34 L62 34 Q70 22 70 14 Z" fill="#7FD6F0" opacity="0.75"/>
  <path d="M30 14 Q30 22 38 34 L62 34 Q70 22 70 14 Z" fill="none" stroke="#D7F6FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- sand in top bulb -->
  <path d="M36 16 Q36 24 43 34 L57 34 Q64 24 64 16 Z" fill="#F6C85F"/>
  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="34" width="3" height="32" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <rect x="49" y="34" width="1" height="32" fill="#FFF1B0"/>
  <!-- bottom bulb glass -->
  <path d="M38 66 Q30 78 30 86 L70 86 Q70 78 62 66 Z" fill="#7FD6F0" opacity="0.75"/>
  <path d="M38 66 Q30 78 30 86 L70 86 Q70 78 62 66 Z" fill="none" stroke="#D7F6FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- pile of sand in bottom bulb -->
  <path d="M36 86 Q38 74 44 68 Q50 64 56 68 Q62 74 64 86 Z" fill="#F6C85F"/>
  <path d="M42 86 Q44 78 48 74 Q50 72 52 74 Q56 78 58 86 Z" fill="#FFD966"/>
  <!-- sand grains detail -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="80" r="1" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="79" r="1" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="83" r="1" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="83" r="1" fill="#FFE699"/>
  <!-- constricted middle neck -->
  <rect x="44" y="32" width="12" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4FB8D9"/>
  <rect x="44" y="64" width="12" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4FB8D9"/>
  <!-- glass shine highlights -->
  <path d="M34 18 Q33 24 38 32" fill="none" stroke="#E8FBFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M34 82 Q34 76 40 70" fill="none" stroke="#E8FBFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- wooden rivets -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#FFCC66"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#FFCC66"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#FFCC66"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#FFCC66"/>
</svg>
